name: Kinder Morgan North Texas Pipeline

values.EndLocation: FPL Energy Forney power plant, Kaufman County

researcher_notes: No existing row: roster has only Gulf South's Lamar County Expansion (P3194, 5.5 mi, different line). Kinder Morgan North Texas Pipeline LLC was announced on October 2, 2001 in an FPL Energy press release, as an 85-mile, 30-inch line from an interconnect in Lamar County to the Forney plant in Kaufman County. The Energy Information Administration pipeline projects workbook of August 2026 (Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 253, project name KMNT FPL Energy Plant, operator North Texas Pipeline Co) lists it as a completed intrastate lateral, in service October 2002, 86 miles, 30 inches, 300 MMcf/d, cost 70 million dollars, authority State. Length is staged as the 86 miles EIA gives for the built line; the 2001 release said 85 miles. Both clear the 25 km length rule (about 138 km). Capacity is EIA additional capacity. Intrastate, so no FERC filing is expected; the Texas Railroad Commission was not checked. Texas RRC or operator confirmation of current operating status is not found; operator is active in PHMSA per the maps candidate. Owner is Kinder Morgan Inc per the team's style; the press release names Kinder Morgan Energy Partners as parent of the builder. Route not researched: no route staged, RouteType unavailable until a state or operator map is found.
